summary: Frontend-only testing of the new PromoVideo pop-up feature and its Studio editor integration on the home page. Verified 5s delayed appearance, all 4 close paths (X button, backdrop, Escape, Maybe later), CTA navigation to /book, sound toggle, sessionStorage-based once-per-visit behaviour, page-scoping (only /), mobile 390px layout, and full Studio editor round-trip (toggle disabled -> hides, custom delay/title/subtitle/CTA/dismiss -> reflected in modal, Reset all to defaults -> restores). Content collection was reset to defaults at the end as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: PromoVideo.jsx: 'once_per_visit' toggle in editor exists but the guard in useEffect (line 18) checks sessionStorage regardless of the toggle value - if V.once_per_visit is false, the code still skips when SEEN_KEY is set. Actually correct: `V.once_per_visit && sessionStorage.getItem(...)` correctly short-circuits when once_per_visit is false. No bug, just noted.

PromoVideo.jsx: When sound is unmuted and modal is re-opened later in the session, `muted` state defaults back to true but the <video> element's `muted` attribute is set to true on mount - fine. However if user closes and re-opens in the same session (currently blocked by once_per_visit) muted state resets which is expected.
StudioEditor.jsx: 'editor-reset-all' button uses window.confirm which is not styled consistently with the rest of the dark theme - minor UX polish, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None; content overrides created temporarily and reverted via 'Reset all to defaults' at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PromoVideo feature is fully working: 5s delay, autoplay-muted-loop video, gold circular close button, backdrop/Escape/Maybe later close paths, CTA -> /book, sound unmute toggle, once-per-visit via sessionStorage 'obw_promo_seen', hidden on /faq /book /studio, mobile 390px fits (modal 358px wide). Studio editor promo_video tab persists changes correctly and 'Reset all to defaults' clears overrides. Note: Escape close requires ~500ms after modal mount for the useEffect to attach keydown listener; not a bug, just test timing. Headless Chromium cannot decode the H.264 mp4 (webm fallback plays) - environment limitation, not a bug per E1's note.
